messages.subject: Moderated mediation - HELP!
parts:
Hello, 

I am struggling to create the code for a moderated mediation model in the picture: 


I have concocked the following code (all vars are centered composite vars made of corresponding items that formed latent vars):

SEM_model4<-'
          #regressions model
          ZEA4items~b1*ZEC3dim+b2*ZESEsum+b3*ZESExZEC
          ZEA2~c*ZEA4items+a1*ZEC3dim+a2*SPOL+a3*DRUZ_BINAR
          #ZEA2~c*ZEA4items
         
          indirect:=b1*b2*b3
          direct:=c*a1*a2*a3
          total:=direct+indirect
          '
SEMfit4_no_boot<-lavaan::sem(SEM_model4, data = df)
summary(SEMfit4_no_boot, fit.measures = T, standardized = T, cov = T, rsquare = T)

I will compare this model to that of my doctoral supervisor. So, the betas are identical. However, I get it totally wrong with the indirect, direct, and total effects because I hammered all together, so I do not get the Matrices like my supervisor does in AMOS, like so:

Later, she gets the bootstrap CIs in the same way.

On top of all this, my fit indices are all off, I have a different NP and consequently df, CFI too small, RMSEA too big.

BTW, I read the following entry: https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/feE0I91tOhM/m/3iXBylp2AAAJ

but it is too different from mine for me to use. But I did see that the indirect, direct, and total effect should be done differently if I want to see the respective effects for each var.

Finally, how do I get the covariances and correlations? 

Thank you for any help!

messages.author: 2537dd572df56eb7
messages.subject: Re: Moderated mediation - HELP!
parts: OK, I nailed it and I am sharing the code that did it:

ZEC3dim~~ZESExZEC
          ZEC3dim~~ZESEsum
          ZESEsum~~ZESExZEC
         
          # key
          ## IV - ZEC3dim
          ## Z - ZESExZEC
          ## M - ZEA4items
          ## DV - ZEA2
          ## ESE - ZESEsum
          ## SPOL - SPOL
          ## DRUZ - DRUZ_BIN
         
          #indirect
          indirect_IV_M_DV:=b1*c
          indirect_Z_M_DV:=b3*c
          indirect_ESE_M_DV:=b2*c
         
         
          #direct
          direct_IV_M:=c
          direct_Z_M:=b3
          direct_IV_M:=b1
          direct_ESE_M:=b2
          direct_IV_DV:=a1
          direct_SPOL_DV:=a2
          direct_DRUZ_DV:=a3
                        
          #total
          Total_IV_DV:=b1*c+a1
          Total_Z_DV:=b3*c+0
          '
The CI values are not the same as with my supervisor but they are sig in the same way. So I got ideas in this group and I thank you. :)
